polymarket.question: Who will win in the upcoming football event New Orleans Saints vs Chicago Bears scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 6:00 PM UTC?
polymarket.description: This market will settle to the winner of the New Orleans Saints vs Chicago Bears professional football game scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 1:00PM ET (as of the listing of the event's first instrument). Overtime is included if played. If the game ends in a tie, the market will settle to $0.50. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended or otherwise rescheduled to a date and time not within two days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.
